# Free Programs

## Explore Our Campus

Walking the docks, visiting the Wagner Education Center, and viewing exhibits is always free. [View our locations here →](https://www.cwb.org/locations)

[Exhibit and Livery Hours Can Be Found Here.](https://www.cwb.org/hourslocations)

## Free Programs for Everyone

### Public Peapod Program

Free one-hour peapod rowboat rentals — walk-up only, first-come, first-served at the floating boatshop. Boats hold up to 4 people. Free rental is not guaranteed; limit one free row per week. Paid rowboats are also available.

### [Public Sail](https://www.cwb.org/public-sail)

Volunteer-skippered sails on Lake Union, 1:00–5:00 PM. Sign up in front of the Wagner Education Center, first-come, first-served.

2026 dates: April 12, May 10 (Mother's Day), June 14 (International Soccer Celebration & Free Boating Day), July 26, August 30, September 27.

[More about public Sail](https://www.cwb.org/public-sail)

### 3rd Friday Speaker Series

Monthly talks, usually 6:00–7:30 PM at the Wagner Education Center. *Currently suspended.*

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1645412976237-73WMBUV7O4VFBWU3SW1W/KarlKruger_Feb22_MorrisLowitz_92.jpeg)

## Free Kids Programs

### Toy Boat Building at South Lake Union

Kids assemble and decorate a wooden toy boat, then test it in the model boat pond at Lake Union Park.

2026 dates (1:00–5:00 PM): April 12, May 10, June 14, July 26, August 30, September 27.

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/8287a703-4fc5-4b5b-9db2-0e81bb33cc48/2023_CWB_FreeBoating_toyboat_08.jpg)

### Wooden Boat Storytime

Sue Kimpton leads storytime in the Boathouse — best for pre-K through early elementary.

2026 dates (2:00–2:45 PM): June 14, July 26, August 30, September 27.

Preview at [www.happytales.me](http://www.happytales.me/). Tugboat Storytime videos are on our [YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/user/centerforwoodenboats).

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/acf73b33-6989-4fb5-a36f-79bdd5e9bdc2/IMG_6938.jpg)
